## Context
The documentation survey on `minimum-rainy-fawn` and session log `homemade-coltish-donkey` identified seven approved repository recommendations. The operator approved F08A, F08B, F09, F10, F12, F13, and all three F19 units. The operator then added F20 to correct the GitHub About description. Rejected F02, F03, and F04 remain excluded. Deferred F05 remains undecided.

## Plan
- Correct bounded README workflow and installation facts.
- Align operation-certificate and import guidance with current implementations and accepted ADRs.
- Complete ADR 0100 command discovery through the existing route registry.
- Repair MCP summary generation and transition registrar wording.
- Correct the generated configuration contract through three bounded F19 children.
- Update GitHub About metadata to lead with enforceable plan review and signed completion verification.
- Use `gh repo edit navapbc/rebar --description` under repository administration rights for F20. Verify exact readback with `gh repo view navapbc/rebar --json description` through the same principal.
- Change generated artifacts only through their canonical sources.
- Sequence children that share generated artifacts. Rebase and regenerate each later child from current `origin/main` before its gates.
- Land each repository child as an independently reviewable Gerrit change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] F08A documents current claim behavior.
- [x] F08A documents current relation behavior.
- [x] F08A documents current unlink behavior.
- [x] F08A documents current help behavior.
- [x] F08A documents current close behavior.
- [x] F08B documents current installation dependencies and Git requirements.
- [x] F09 distinguishes asymmetric operation certificates from generic and legacy HMAC records.
- [x] F10 documents import batching.
- [x] F10 documents partial results.
- [x] F10 documents rerun behavior.
- [x] F10 documents recovery limits.
- [x] F12 makes every visible top-level route discoverable through supported help forms.
- [x] F13 emits complete MCP summaries and correct transition semantics.
- [x] F19A removes the nonexistent MCP configuration-surface claim.
- [x] F19B generates a public description for every emitted typed configuration key.
- [x] F19C corrects current configuration history and diagnostic-switch guidance.
- [x] [non-codebase] F20 updates the GitHub About description.
      provenance: environment=GitHub repository metadata for navapbc/rebar; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — The authenticated description write and exact readback are recorded on F20.
- [x] [non-codebase] F20 leaves repository files unchanged.
      provenance: environment=navapbc/rebar repository and origin/main; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — F20 records a metadata-only write and no repository commit.
- [x] [non-codebase] F20 leaves topics unchanged.
      provenance: environment=GitHub repository metadata for navapbc/rebar; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — The F20 metadata observation records unchanged topics.
- [x] [non-codebase] F20 leaves the homepage unchanged.
      provenance: environment=GitHub repository metadata for navapbc/rebar; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — The F20 metadata observation records the unchanged homepage.
- [x] Every repository child passes its applicable local checks.
- [x] [non-codebase] Every repository child receives LLM-Review +1 before merge.
      provenance: environment=Gerrit changes for navapbc/rebar; principal=rebar review-bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Each repository child records its Gerrit label result before merge.
- [x] [non-codebase] Every repository child receives Verified +1 before merge.
      provenance: environment=Gerrit and GitHub Actions for navapbc/rebar; principal=GitHub Actions and Gerrit CI integration; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Each repository child records its passing CI run and Gerrit label before merge.
- [x] [non-codebase] The GitHub metadata child passes plan review before close.
      provenance: environment=rebar ticket store for aimless-seclusive-tigershark; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — F20 records its signed plan-review attestation before its close.
- [x] [non-codebase] The GitHub metadata child receives exact readback verification before close.
      provenance: environment=GitHub repository metadata for navapbc/rebar; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — F20 records the exact 236-character description readback and observation time.
- [x] [non-codebase] The repository batch is merged to `main`.
      provenance: environment=Gerrit main and the origin/main mirror; principal=Gerrit Submit and mirror automation; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Child completion attestations name every merged commit.
- [x] [non-codebase] Every descendant closes without force.
      provenance: environment=rebar tickets branch; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Descendant states are closed and their event histories contain no forced transition.
